objects.description: [AADInternals](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0677) can inject a malicious DLL (`PTASpy`) into the `AzureADConnectAuthenticationAgentService` to backdoor Azure AD Pass-Through Authentication.(Citation: AADInternals Azure AD On-Prem to Cloud)
objects.description_fa: [AADInternals](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0677) می‌تواند یک DLL مخرب ("PTASpy") را به "AzureADConnectAuthenticationAgentService" برای احراز هویت عبور از طریق AD Azure در پشتی تزریق کند.[[[CTI_PRESERVE_0]] (Citation: AADInternals Azure AD On-Prem to Cloud)
